title: Factory 360
loadingDetail: Loading the selected registration, license and recorded source metadata.

permission.title: Factory 360 access required
permission.body: You do not have access to this factory profile.

notFound.title: Factory 360 profile unavailable
notFound.body: Factory registration not found or not available to you.
notFound.neutral: The factory list is temporarily unavailable. Nothing was changed.

source.heading: Source status and freshness
source.noSla: Freshness is shown as a recorded source fact; no unapproved staleness threshold is inferred.

section.degraded: This source section is degraded; other sections remain available.

licenses.heading: Licenses and plants
licenses.empty: No industrial license is mapped to this CR.
licenses.degraded: Industrial-license data is temporarily degraded; CR identity remains available.

cr.heading: Commercial registration and legal identity
cr.openViolationsUnavailable: Not available — these violations do not record whether they are open or closed
cr.activePenaltiesUnavailable: Not available — current penalty statuses do not define Active/Expired/Cancelled
cr.noAggregate: All-licenses facts only. No CR-level risk score or compliance rate is calculated.

license.heading: Selected license, plant and address
license.unavailable: Select a mapped industrial license to load plant facts.

visits.heading: Visit summary
visits.boundary: Operational context only. Inspection answers, evidence, findings, reviewer comments and personal contact data are excluded.
visits.filteredEmpty: No visits match the selected filters.

observed.heading: Official vs latest approved observed snapshot
observed.rule: The observed column shows the official record as it was when someone submitted a report that was later approved. It does not change the current official record.
observed.empty: No approved report has a factory record for this licence yet.

compliance.heading: Approved inspection compliance
compliance.rule: Calculated only from the latest final submitted version of approved inspections and the checklist version used for the inspection. Returned or rejected inspections stay visible below, but they never affect this rate.
compliance.trendCaption: Approved-inspection compliance rate, oldest to newest.

reports.heading: Inspection reports
reports.empty: No inspection reports are available for the selected plant.

violations.heading: Approved inspection violations and corrective actions
violations.title: Violation
violations.empty: No violations from approved inspection reports are visible in your scope.

industrial.heading: Industrial information
industrial.empty: No source-backed products, spare parts, machines, production lines or raw materials are available.

government.heading: Government records
government.empty: Government records are not available until an agreed source supplies them.

chemicalCustoms.heading: Chemical permits and customs exemptions
chemicalCustoms.noPlant: No plant number on the selected license — chemical permits and customs exemptions are looked up by plant number.

chemicalPermits.heading: Chemical permits
chemicalPermits.empty: No chemical permits found for this plant.

customsExemptions.heading: Customs exemptions
customsExemptions.empty: No customs exemptions found for this plant.

documents.heading: Documents and factory media
documents.restrictedBody: Document metadata requires Factory Documents permission.
documents.empty: No source-backed document metadata is available.

media.boundary: Only official factory/profile media appears here. Inspection evidence remains linked to its inspection report and is never merged into this gallery.
media.evidenceEmpty: No linked inspection, arrival or violation evidence is visible in your scope.

timeline.heading: Business-event timeline
timeline.rule: Source-backed sync, visit, submission, approval, penalty and risk events.
timeline.empty: No business events are available for the selected license.

xpc.heading: Source and cross-provider reconciliation
xpc.rule: Facts are checked once, by the system. Industry Shared master data is not verified yet, so it is not used. Inspection API values give context. Approved report facts are the most reliable. If facts conflict, we show the conflict — we never hide or overwrite it.

risk.heading: Saved risk
risk.restricted: Risk detail requires Factory Risk permission.
risk.source: Inspection Platform-calculated advisory. It does not change the master record.
risk.aiDescription: Advisory only. The explanation is restricted to saved Risk Engine facts and cannot recalculate or change risk.

enforcement.heading: Penalty history
enforcement.empty: No penalty notices are visible in your scope.

actions.heading: Actions
actions.restricted: No create-inspection or export action is permitted for your role.
